## Data Analytics Projects

### Market-Entry Analysis
`MySQL` · `SQL` · `Tableau`

Queried a 9-table marketplace database to decide whether an online tech retailer
should partner with a Brazilian platform. Found that ~93% of orders arrive on time
and tech makes up ~14% of revenue; recommended signing the deal and presented the
results in a Tableau dashboard.

[GitHub repository →](https://github.com/Om4143/eniac-magist-analysis)

### Playlist Clustering for a Music Startup
`Python` · `Scikit-learn` · `Spotify API`

Built a K-Means model that grouped 5,000+ Spotify songs into 34 playlists of
50–250 songs each, to test whether machine learning can replace manual curation.
Cleaned the data (duplicates, outliers, feature selection), compared 5 scaling
methods and reduced 9 audio features with PCA while keeping 95% of the variance.
Published the playlists via the Spotify Web API and explained the limits to a
non-technical audience: the model makes good first drafts, but an expert should
still review them.

[GitHub repository →](https://github.com/Om4143/moosic-playlist-clustering)

### Automated Cloud Data Pipeline for E-Scooter Demand Analysis
`Python` · `MySQL` · `BeautifulSoup` · `REST APIs` · `Google Cloud`

Built an end-to-end ETL pipeline that scrapes city data from Wikipedia, pulls
weather forecasts and flight schedules from REST APIs, and loads everything into a
5-table MySQL database on Google Cloud SQL. Deployed it as Cloud Run functions
triggered by Cloud Scheduler, with duplicate-free re-runs and credentials stored in
Secret Manager. Handled missing fields, empty responses, rate limits and timezone
differences, and debugged production failures from Cloud Run logs.

[GitHub repository →](https://github.com/Om4143/gans-data-pipeline)

### Discount Strategy Analysis
`Python` · `Pandas`

Cleaned three raw sales tables (malformed prices, 8,700+ duplicate rows) and tested
whether discounts pay off. Sales stop rising above a 20% discount, and budget items
get the deepest cuts but bring in only 5.9% of revenue; recommended capping
discounts at 20% and shifting them to high-end products.

[GitHub repository →](https://github.com/Om4143/eniac-discount-strategy)

### A/B Test of Homepage Buttons
`Python` · `SciPy` · `Statistics`

Compared four button designs across ~100,000 homepage visits using a chi-square
test with Bonferroni-corrected pairwise tests. White buttons clearly beat red ones
(2.0–2.1% vs. 0.8–1.1% click-through rate); the two white versions showed no
significant difference.

[GitHub repository →](https://github.com/Om4143/eniac-ab-test-chi-square)

### Smartwatch Activity Dashboard
`BigQuery` · `Tableau`

Cleaned 960 days of personal Samsung Health data in BigQuery and built a Tableau
dashboard; found the 10,000-step goal rate rose from under 30% to 73% in 2026.

[GitHub repository →](https://github.com/Om4143/samsung-health-analysis) ·
[Tableau Public portfolio →](https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/omveer.singh)

## Research & Software Engineering

### QA framework & CI/CD for detector data (CBM / FAIR)
`Python` · `C++` · `CI/CD` · `ROOT`

Built a Python and C++ QA framework that automatically checks large simulation and
detector datasets, so problems no longer had to be found by hand. Added these
checks to the CI pipeline, so errors showed up as soon as the code changed.

[GitHub repository →](https://github.com/Om4143/CbmRootFramework)

### CAD → GDML → ROOT geometry pipeline
`C++` · `Python` · `CAD` · `ROOT`

Engineered a pipeline ingesting complex 3D CAD geometry models into simulation
workflows. Achieved an **8× runtime reduction** by replacing tessellated models
with optimised primitives while preserving physics and material accuracy.

[GitLab →](https://git.cbm.gsi.de/osingh)

### CMake build-system modernisation (CbmRoot)
`C++` · `CMake` · `build systems`

Moved a large, old build system to modern **CMake**, which made the code easier
to maintain. Wrote the developer documentation, which the collaboration adopted
as its standard.
